title: abies durangensis var. coahuilensis
intro: Abies durangensis var. coahuilensis, commonly known as Coahuila Fir or Coahuila Balsam Fir, is a variety of fir tree native to the mountainous regions of Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Abies durangensis var. coahuilensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve congestion and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
